meta.title: Statistical Reasoning | Interactive Course
meta.description: An interactive course on statistical reasoning with R in the browser: heuristics and biases, base-rate fallacy, regression to the mean, Simpson's paradox, robust statistics, the Bayesian paradigm and algorithmic decision-making.

home.title: Statistical Reasoning
home.tagline: Eight modules on learning when to distrust your own intuition. You get it wrong first, then you see the trap, and only then does the formal tool arrive. Actually, the error is the method.
home.quote: We are prone to overestimate how much we understand about the world and to underestimate the role of chance in events.
